camera_registration.central_only_supervision_with_full_viewp: NOT_CURRENTLY_SUPPORTED because no independent pixel validity reaches all losses and evaluation.
camera_registration.cx_new: Supported only after materializing cx-x_left into consumed K.
camera_registration.cy_new: Supported only after materializing cy+top_extension into consumed K for the full portrait viewport.
camera_registration.manifest_binding: Possible only when the manifest is converted into the actual dataset/camera records; V2 preflight is not read automatically.
camera_registration.per_view_override: YES in per-record dressable camera JSON; base calibration is per camera, not per frame.
camera_registration.viewport_or_ndc_update: Width/height and K define the gsplat viewport; no additional repository NDC update was found.

evidence.finding: Subject00 uses image_scaling=1; no 1024x1536 constant is configured.
evidence.question: configured_resize

evidence.finding: At scaling=1 source HxW is preserved and sample height/width come from the loaded image. The non-unit path has a dormant NameError because line 68 references msk instead of mask.
evidence.question: base_image_size

evidence.finding: Global image_scaling is shared, while DataLoader batch_size=1 permits varying sample HxW technically. Camera K is collected per camera rather than per frame.
evidence.question: base_batching

evidence.finding: A common arbitrary HxW is accepted, but line 239 rejects rendering samples that do not all share one image size.
evidence.question: formal_teacher_size

evidence.finding: Per-record K or intrinsics and w2c or R/T are accepted and passed with explicit H/W. Crop/outpaint formulas are not applied automatically; corrected K must be written into the consumed camera data.
evidence.question: camera_override

evidence.finding: gsplat rasterization consumes cam K, width, and height directly; there is no separate repository NDC transform to update.
evidence.question: renderer_viewport

evidence.finding: L1 and evaluation L1/PSNR do not accept an independent validity mask. LPIPS uses a person-mask-derived crop, not a registered central validity region.
evidence.question: base_losses_and_evaluation

evidence.finding: The crop is based on foreground bbox and resized to 512; exclusion of portrait bands is incidental, not a validity contract.
evidence.question: base_lpips_crop

evidence.finding: RGB L1/SSIM use the supplied foreground mask, alpha loss covers the full image, and LPIPS is unmasked. No separate validity mask reaches every loss.
evidence.question: rendering_losses

evidence.finding: Existing valid_mask is per-anchor and reference_valid_mask is [K] or [K,1] per view. Neither is an HxW pixel-validity region.
evidence.question: valid_mask_name_collision

evidence.finding: Foreground/clothing masks drive losses and IoU, but no independent validity region is consumed by losses or metrics.
evidence.question: oracle_losses_and_evaluation

technical_scientific_distinction.geometrically_registered: Requires RGB/masks and a consumed K containing cx_new=cx-x_left and, only for a portrait canvas, cy_new=cy+top_extension.
technical_scientific_distinction.scientifically_valid: Requires verified scene registration and complete invalid-region exclusion from optimization and evaluation; current code does not satisfy this for portrait bands.
technical_scientific_distinction.technically_parsable: Base MMLP-Human can parse/render arbitrary HxW at scaling=1; formal Teacher rendering can use one common arbitrary HxW.

validity_mask.alpha_silhouette: NO independent validity; invalid bands would still affect alpha BCE/dice/IoU.
validity_mask.full_output_provenance: YES; retain the full output/contact sheet for provenance while excluding invalid bands from supervision.
validity_mask.image_l1: NO independent validity; base full image, dressable uses foreground mask.
validity_mask.lpips: NO independent validity; dressable full image, base person crop, oracle foreground-multiplied.
validity_mask.regularization: Parameter regularizers are not pixel-local and require an explicit scientific decision rather than implicit masking.
validity_mask.required: A new HxW validity_mask aligned through every transform, loss, and metric.
validity_mask.ssim: NO independent validity; zeroing outside foreground can contaminate windows at boundaries.
